provenance.source: OpenStreetMap, queried through Overpass for water, waterways, green space and railways.
provenance.licence: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Derived data must credit OSM.
provenance.not_stamped: Not stamped: this file predates provenance recording. The next run of the script named in made_by fills generated and generated_utc with a real date. A fetch date was deliberately NOT back-filled from the git log, which records when a result was committed rather than when the source was read.
provenance.how_to_update: Run refresh_boundary.py first: the bounding box is read from boundary.json. Then refresh_landcover.py.
